verses.original: Τὰ τέκνα ὑπακούετε ὑμῶν τοῖς γονεῦσιν ἐν Κυρίῳ γάρ τοῦτο ἐστιν δίκαιον
verses.transliteration: Ta tekna hypakouete hymōn tois goneusin en Kyriō gar touto estin dikaion
verses.literal: - Children obey your - parents in [the] Lord for this is right

verses.original: Τίμα σου τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα ἥτις ἐστὶν πρώτη ἐντολὴ ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Tima sou ton patera kai tēn mētera hētis estin prōtē entolē en epangelia
verses.literal: Honor your - father and - mother (which is the first commandment with a promise)

verses.original: Ἵνα γένηται εὖ σοι καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Hina genētai eu soi kai esē makrochronios epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: that it may go well with you and [that] you may have a long life on the earth

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες μὴ παροργίζετε ὑμῶν τὰ τέκνα ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi pateres mē parorgizete hymōn ta tekna alla ektrephete auta en paideia kai nouthesia Kyriou
verses.literal: - - Fathers {do} not provoke your - children {to wrath} instead bring them up . . . in [the] discipline and instruction of [the] Lord

verses.original: Οἱ δοῦλοι ὑπακούετε τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς ὑμῶν καρδίας ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Hoi douloi hypakouete tois kata sarka kyriois meta phobou kai tromou en haplotēti tēs hymōn kardias hōs tō Christō
verses.literal: - Slaves obey [your] earthly . . . masters with respect and fear [and] sincerity of - heart just as [ you would obey ] Christ

verses.original: μὴ ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι κατ’ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ἀλλ’ ὡς δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκ ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: mē hōs anthrōpareskoi kat’ ophthalmodoulian all’ hōs douloi Christou poiountes to thelēma tou Theou ek psychēs
verses.literal: [And do this] not only vvv to please them vvv while they are watching but as servants of Christ doing the will - of God from [your] heart

verses.original: δουλεύοντες μετ’ εὐνοίας ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: douleuontes met’ eunoias hōs tō Kyriō kai ouk anthrōpois
verses.literal: Serve with good will as to the Lord and not to men

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι παρὰ Κυρίου τοῦτο κομίσεται ἕκαστος ἐάν τι ἀγαθόν ποιήσῃ εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti para Kyriou touto komisetai hekastos ean ti agathon poiēsē eite doulos eite eleutheros
verses.literal: because you know that - [the] Lord - will reward each one vvv for whatever good he does whether [he is] slave or free

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι ποιεῖτε τὰ αὐτὰ πρὸς αὐτούς ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ αὐτῶν ὁ Κύριός καὶ ὑμῶν ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἔστιν οὐκ προσωπολημψία παρ’ αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi kyrioi poieite ta auta pros autous anientes tēn apeilēn eidotes hoti kai autōn ho Kyrios kai hymōn estin en ouranois kai estin ouk prosōpolēmpsia par’ autō
verses.literal: And - masters do the same . . . for [your slaves] Give up [your] use of threats because you know that [He who is] both their - Master and yours is in heaven and there is no favoritism with Him

verses.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῆς αὐτοῦ τῷ κράτει ἰσχύος
verses.transliteration: Tou loipou endynamousthe en Kyriō kai en tēs autou tō kratei ischyos
verses.literal: - Finally be strong in [the] Lord and in vvv His - mighty power

verses.original: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ δύνασθαι στῆναι πρὸς τὰς τοῦ διαβόλου μεθοδείας
verses.transliteration: endysasthe tēn panoplian tou Theou pros hymas to dynasthai stēnai pros tas tou diabolou methodeias
verses.literal: Put on the full armor - of God so that you - can make your stand against the - devil’s schemes

verses.original: ὅτι ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη ἔστιν οὐκ πρὸς σάρκα καὶ αἷμα ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ τούτου σκότους πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.transliteration: hoti hēmin hē palē estin ouk pros sarka kai haima alla pros tas archas pros tas exousias pros tous kosmokratoras tou toutou skotous pros ta pneumatika tēs ponērias en tois epouraniois
verses.literal: For our - struggle is not against flesh and blood but against the rulers against the authorities against the powers of this {world’s} darkness [and] against the spiritual [forces] - of evil in the heavenly realms

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι καὶ κατεργασάμενοι ἅπαντα στῆναι
verses.transliteration: Dia touto analabete tēn panoplian tou Theou hina en tē hēmera tē ponēra dynēthēte antistēnai kai katergasamenoi hapanta stēnai
verses.literal: Therefore - take up the full armor - of God so that when the day - of evil {comes} you will be able to stand your ground and having done everything to stand

verses.original: στῆτε οὖν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ περιζωσάμενοι ὑμῶν τὴν ὀσφὺν καὶ τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἐνδυσάμενοι
verses.transliteration: stēte oun en alētheia perizōsamenoi hymōn tēn osphyn kai ton thōraka tēs dikaiosynēs endysamenoi
verses.literal: Stand firm then with {the belt of} truth buckled around your - waist [with] the breastplate - of righteousness arrayed

verses.original: καὶ τοὺς πόδας ὑποδησάμενοι ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης
verses.transliteration: kai tous podas hypodēsamenoi en hetoimasia tou euangeliou tēs eirēnēs
verses.literal: and [with your] feet fitted with [the] readiness of the gospel - of peace

verses.original: ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε σβέσαι πάντα τὰ πεπυρωμένα τὰ βέλη τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: en pasin analabontes ton thyreon tēs pisteōs en hō dynēsesthe sbesai panta ta pepyrōmena ta belē tou ponērou
verses.literal: In addition to all [this] take up the shield - of faith with which you can extinguish all the flaming - arrows of the evil one

verses.original: καὶ δέξασθε τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ Πνεύματος ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai dexasthe tēn perikephalaian tou sōtēriou kai tēn machairan tou Pneumatos ho estin rhēma Theou
verses.literal: And take the helmet - of salvation and the sword of the Spirit which is [the] word of God

verses.original: προσευχόμενοι ἐν Πνεύματι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως καὶ εἰς αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: proseuchomenoi en Pneumati en panti kairō dia pasēs proseuchēs kai deēseōs kai eis auto agrypnountes en pasē proskarterēsei kai deēsei peri pantōn tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: Pray in [the] Spirit at all times with every kind of prayer and petition - To this [end] stay alert with all perseverance - in your prayers for all the saints

verses.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ ἵνα ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ μου στόματός λόγος δοθῇ μοι ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: kai hyper emou hina en anoixei tou mou stomatos logos dothē moi en parrēsia gnōrisai to mystērion tou euangeliou
verses.literal: [Pray] also for me that whenever I open - my mouth words may be given me vvv [so that I will] boldly make known the mystery of the gospel

verses.original: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει ἵνα παρρησιάσωμαι ἐν αὐτῷ ὡς με δεῖ λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: hyper hou presbeuō en halysei hina parrēsiasōmai en autō hōs me dei lalēsai
verses.literal: for which I am an ambassador in chains [Pray] that I may proclaim it fearlessly . . . . . . as I should -

verses.original: Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν Κυρίῳ γνωρίσει ὑμῖν πάντα δὲ Ἵνα ὑμεῖς καὶ εἰδῆτε τὰ κατ’ ἐμέ τί πράσσω
verses.transliteration: Tychikos ho agapētos adelphos kai pistos diakonos en Kyriō gnōrisei hymin panta de Hina hymeis kai eidēte ta kat’ eme ti prassō
verses.literal: Tychicus the beloved brother and faithful servant in [the] Lord will tell you everything - so that you also may know - about me [and] what I am doing

verses.original: ἔπεμψα ὃν πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας
verses.transliteration: epempsa hon pros hymas eis auto touto hina gnōte ta peri hēmōn kai parakalesē hymōn tas kardias
verses.literal: I have sent [him] to you for this very purpose that you may know - about us and [that] he may encourage your - hearts

verses.original: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eirēnē tois adelphois kai agapē meta pisteōs apo Theou Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God [the] Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων ἡμῶν τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hē charis meta pantōn tōn agapōntōn hēmōn ton Kyrion Iēsoun Christon en aphtharsia
verses.literal: - Grace to all who love our - Lord Jesus Christ with an undying [love]
